Spot mode

SpotMargin

Suitable for beginner traders.

When borrowing is off, you’ll trade using only your crypto balance, with no risk of liquidation.
When borrowing is on, you can trade using your assets as collateral, based on their USD value.

Futures mode

✓
SpotMarginPerpetualExpiryOptions

Suitable for spot and derivative traders.

Your cross-margin futures and options trades with the same margin crypto will share margin, and profits and losses will offset each other. In the event of liquidation, only assets of that margin crypto can be lost.
Supports simultaneous cross- and isolated-margin trades.

Advanced mode

SpotMarginPerpetualExpiryOptions

Choose which assets to use as your margin collateral.

Suitable for derivatives traders who want high capital efficiency and have strong risk-management abilities.

Use of funds
You set your margin collateral crypto, which will be used as margin based on its USD value. Cross positions that use the same or different crypto as margin share risk and offset profits and losses. Liquidation can result in the loss of any collateral assets.
Supports simultaneous cross- and isolated-margin trades.
